description: Latest SIP quote data. Retrieve the latest quote data for up to 10 symbols. Successful rows include the current bid and ask. → Returns {last_update?: number|null, total_items: number, data: [{code: string, status: string, quote_time: number, bid: number, ask: number, bid_size?: number, ask_size?: number, last_price?: number, lp_time?: number, luld?: object, trading_status?: object}|{code: string, error: string, message?: string}]}. Use get_sip_series for historical bars.

codes.description: Comma-separated list of SIP-prefixed symbol codes. Each code must match the SipSymbolCode pattern.

filter.description: (Optional) JSONata expression to return only the fields or rows you need. See https://jsonata.org for syntax.

output_dir.description: Directory for stored response when output_file is not set.

store.description: Store the response locally instead of returning it. Default is none. csv is only supported for get_symbol_series.

name: get_sip_quotes
